figurative_meaning_en: Varied and colorful, adorned in various hues
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে রংচঙা ফুলের তোড়া দেখে মনটা প্রফুল্ল হয়ে গেল।
সেই উৎসবে সবাই রঙচঙে পোশাক পরে এসেছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: The riot of colorful flowers in the market lifted my spirits.
Everyone came to the festival dressed in vibrant, multicolored attire.
note: This idiom is commonly used in everyday descriptive language in Bengali literature and speech to evoke vivid imagery.
